argument.script: async (intermediate) => { const user_id = '{{ user_id }}'; const panelTop = document.querySelector('.woo-panel-main.woo-panel-top'); const followBtn = panelTop ? panelTop.querySelector('button.woo-button-main') : null; const btnText = followBtn ? (followBtn.innerText || followBtn.textContent || '').trim() : ''; const isFollowing = btnText.includes('已关注') || btnText.includes('Following') || btnText.includes('互相关注') || btnText.includes('好友'); if (isFollowing) { return [{ status: 'success', message: 'Already following this user', user_id }]; } if (followBtn) { followBtn.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000)); return [{ status: 'success', message: 'Follow button clicked', user_id }]; } return [{ status: 'error', message: 'Follow button not found', user_id }]; }
